final: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM matched), telescope_weather AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshift FROM matched GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile) SELECT tw.weathprofile, AVG(tw.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(tw.avg_phaseshift) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(tw.avg_modindex - overall.avg_modindex) AS avg_above_overall FROM telescope_weather AS tw CROSS JOIN overall WHERE tw.avg_modindex > overall.avg_modindex GROUP BY tw.weathprofile
